seo.title: Merchant Center AI Performance Insights Explained
seo.meta_description: Merchant Center AI performance insights show retailers their share of voice in AI Mode and AI Overviews. What Anaheim and Orange County retailers should do now.

h1: Merchant Center AI Performance Insights: See How Shoppers Find You in AI Search
answer: Merchant Center AI performance insights, now available in the U.S., Australia, Canada, India and New Zealand, show retailers how their brand and products are discovered in AI Mode and AI Overviews, comparing share of voice with other brands. Google paired them with feed tips such as conversational attributes. Anaheim and Orange County retailers can use them to improve how AI shopping features present their products.
key_takeaways: Available in the U.S., Australia, Canada, India and New Zealand.
Compares your share of voice in AI Mode and AI Overviews.
Feed best practices linked to 5% more conversions on average.
Conversational attributes add context for AI recommendations.

sections.heading: What Google announced
sections.body_html: On September 16, 2026, Google shared agentic commerce updates for the holiday season. Among them, AI performance insights in Merchant Center became available to businesses in Australia, Canada, India, New Zealand and the U.S.

sections.heading: What AI performance insights show
sections.body_html: Google says the feature gives retailers a view of how their brand and products are discovered by comparing share of voice with other brands across surfaces like AI Mode and AI Overviews, and helps them take action to improve discoverability.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.body_html: Google notes that shoppers increasingly turn to AI to discover products, compare options and decide what to buy. Knowing whether your products appear in those conversations, and how you compare, is new information for most retailers.

sections.heading: Feed best practices
sections.body_html: Google says that, on average, merchants adopting core Merchant Center feed best practices see a 5% increase in conversions the following month. An accurate product feed is the foundation for showing up in AI shopping experiences.

sections.heading: Conversational attributes
sections.body_html: Google suggests submitting conversational attributes to add richer context to listings. In testing with lululemon, Google says conversational attributes from the brand were used 50% of the time in relevant product recommendations in AI Mode.

sections.heading: Video and loyalty
sections.body_html: Google also suggests adding the video link attribute to power shoppable ad formats, and connecting loyalty data in Merchant Center to show member pricing and perks across Google.

sections.heading: Business Agent in YouTube ads
sections.body_html: Google invited U.S. retailers into a Business Agent for YouTube ads beta, which lets viewers ask product questions and get guidance inside YouTube ads.

sections.heading: Universal Commerce Protocol updates
sections.body_html: Google says the Universal Commerce Protocol already enables direct checkout for hundreds of thousands of brands, and that merchants using the Merchant Center hub can now enable cart transfer to their site and enhanced checkout testing, rolling out in the U.S. first.

sections.heading: What local retailers should do
sections.body_html:
1. Set up or review your Merchant Center account and product feed.
  2. Fix feed errors and fill in key attributes.
  3. Add conversational attributes that describe who each product is for.
  4. Check AI performance insights for your categories.
  5. Keep product pages on your website detailed and current.

sections.heading: Local stock too
sections.body_html: Shoppers using AI to research gifts still often buy locally. Keep store hours, stock and pickup options clear on your website and Business Profile so AI research turns into a visit.

sections.heading: A worked example
sections.body_html: Imagine a home goods boutique in Newport Beach with a small online store. After reviewing its Merchant Center feed, it fixes missing attributes and adds conversational details such as gift for new homeowners and pairs with our linen line. It then checks AI performance insights monthly to see whether its share of voice in its categories improves.

sections.heading: Questions retailers ask us
sections.body_html: Retailers often ask whether a small store can compete for share of voice with big brands. In niche categories, specific products with detailed, accurate data can stand out, especially when conversational attributes describe exactly who a product suits. Another common question is where to start with feed best practices. Fix errors and warnings in Merchant Center first, then complete titles, descriptions, images, prices and availability. Retailers also ask how often to check insights. Monthly is enough for most small stores, with a closer look before and during the holiday season.

sections.heading: Writing conversational attributes
sections.body_html: Think about how a shopper would describe what they need to an AI assistant: a gift for a dad who likes grilling, a waterproof jacket for a rainy trip, a non-toxic toy for a toddler. Describe your products in those terms, accurately and without exaggeration, so AI shopping features can match them to real requests.

sections.heading: Why AI shopping changes product data
sections.body_html: When shoppers ask an AI assistant for a gift idea or a product that fits a specific need, the assistant relies on product data to decide what to recommend. Titles, descriptions, images, prices, availability and extra attributes all help it understand what a product is and who it's for. Retailers with thin or inconsistent product data are harder to recommend. That's why Google pairs AI performance insights with feed best practices: the insights show where you stand, and the feed is how you improve it.

sections.heading: A holiday feed checklist
sections.body_html:
• Fix all errors and warnings in Merchant Center.
  • Make titles specific: brand, product type, key feature, size or color.
  • Use clear, real product images.
  • Keep prices and availability accurate daily during the holidays.
  • Add conversational attributes for gift-relevant products.
  • Add video links where you have product videos.
  • Connect loyalty perks if you run a program.

For Orange County retailers, these steps also help shoppers who search for local stock and pickup.

sections.heading: Questions to ask about your product data
sections.body_html: Before the holiday rush, ask a few simple questions. Would a shopper understand each product from its title alone? Do descriptions say who the product is for and what problem it solves? Are images clear and current? Do prices and stock match your store? Do your best-selling products have the richest data? If the answer to any is no, fix your top products first, since they matter most to sales. For Orange County retailers with both a shop and an online store, accurate product data serves shoppers whether they buy online or visit in person, and it gives AI shopping features something solid to recommend. Revisit the same questions after the holidays, when returns and new stock change what's accurate, and keep improving the products that sell best year-round. Small, regular improvements to product data compound over time, just as they do for your website and listings.

sections.heading: The short version
sections.body_html: Merchant Center AI performance insights show retailers how they're discovered in AI Mode and AI Overviews. Anaheim and Orange County retailers should clean up their feeds, add conversational attributes and check insights regularly.

faqs.q: What are Merchant Center AI performance insights?
faqs.a: Reports showing how your brand and products are discovered in AI Mode and AI Overviews, with share of voice.
Google says the U.S., Australia, Canada, India and New Zealand.
Extra product details that add context for AI recommendations.
Google says merchants adopting them see 5% more conversions on average the following month.

faqs.q: What is Business Agent for YouTube ads?
faqs.a: A beta letting viewers ask product questions inside YouTube ads.

faqs.q: Is Universal Commerce Protocol checkout available?
faqs.a: Google says it already powers direct checkout for hundreds of thousands of brands.

faqs.q: Do small retailers need Merchant Center?
faqs.a: If they sell products online, it's how products reach Google's shopping features.

faqs.q: Do you work with businesses in Anaheim and Orange County?
faqs.a: Yes. Chimera is based in Anaheim, California and works with businesses across Orange County, California, from Anaheim and Santa Ana to Irvine and the coastal cities.
